name: Ottoman minaret
_about: AN OTTOMAN MINARET: slender, on a tall polygonal pedestal, `balconies` balconies high up the shaft (the `minaret` component on the pedestal, its balconies spaced by `tier` rather than filling the shaft), the shaft running on above the last, and the pencil cap -- a tall lead cone -- with its finial.

params._foot: the pedestal; on it the `minaret`'s own plinth (1.2m, its default) and the shaft, h tall
params._tier: a balcony every `tier` from the plinth's top -- fewer than h / tier, so the shaft runs on over the last; the cap `capRise` tall

pedestal._about: the tall polygonal base, up to the roofs

minaret._about: the `minaret` on it: its plinth (1.2m), the shaft and its balconies, one every `tier` from the plinth's top

cap._about: the lead pencil cap on the shaft's head
